location.basis: coordinate-space centroid of the disclosed provisional WGS84 site geometry; low-confidence orientation seed; zero altitude used for geometric comparison

receptors.exchange: four 3 m exterior public approaches; the all-weather central hall is excluded
receptors.origin: Care, Forum and Learning courts separately, minus authored building footprints
receptors.proof: controlled field minus authored building footprints
receptors.supplemental_human_routes: Proof observation route and Origin public lane are reported separately and never averaged into the activity-area mean

shade_layers.building: swept ground shadow of each vertical prism
shade_layers.fixed_typed_roof: horizontal typed roof shadow active in winter and summer; recorded separately from building shadow
shade_layers.hot_season_retractable_roof: horizontal typed seasonal roof shadow active in June and July only and asserted absent from winter masks
shade_layers.tree: horizontal opaque crown disk translated from analyst-assumed crown height; summer sensitivity only
shade_layers.weather_cover: authored roof footprint overlap reported separately from projected solar shade

solar_position.altitude_policy: 0 m comparison datum; site altitude is not asserted and the study is geometric
solar_position.method: NREL SPA, numpy implementation, delta_t calculated by pvlib
